title: Authority-free colony telemetry
goal: Show live Legion health in the T590-hosted Command Deck without granting tablet/phone or telemetry transport any execution authority.
laws: Reuse bounded Mycelium transport; no arbitrary telemetry fields.
Telemetry token is machine-local and never committed.
T590 may persist only the latest validated Legion status outside Git.
Telemetry grants no task, mutation, acceptance, release, or control authority.
Stale telemetry must be visibly stale, never implied live.
